Specification: This module is a small illustrative TLA+ specification focused on annotated declarations rather than a full transition-system model. It defines an integer constant N, a variable set intended to range over sets of integers, and several arithmetic operators including increment, a LOCAL increment helper, a LET-defined helper, and two factorial-style recursive definitions. The file does not define an Init/Next style system, no temporal behavior or fault model is specified, and no correctness properties are asserted beyond the mathematical operator definitions present.
